verdicts.evidence: Equivalence by subsumption, proven then swept. The replacement text only matters if hit ends in ".md"; but every hit whose stripped form would be "ADR-0+" has the form "ADR-0+.md", already caught by the FIRST disjunct (zeros then .md$) in both builds — the second disjunct therefore only decides names WITHOUT an extension, where replace() is a no-op on both sides; and a string ending in "Stryker was here!" can never match /^ADR-0+$/. Sensitivity control: the neighbouring input where the two replace calls diverge is "ADR-000.md" ("ADR-000" against "ADR-000Stryker was here!") — exactly the one the first disjunct already decides, in both builds, so the divergence is unobservable. Measured: exhaustive sweep of 4 000 145 names (alphabet {A,D,R,-,0,1,.,m,d} up to length 7, plus the structured edge names ADR-<zeros><suffixes>) -> 0 divergence of the condition; CLI identical on r-zeros (exit 1, same message), g-dev, g-mdbak, g-titleref (exit 0); function probes identical (no-adr/empty/template/healthy).

This is exactly the attack of the 2026-08-04 audit (36 deviations on a 0-byte file) moved one notch: from 0 bytes to padding. Replayed against the seven legs with the mutated build: all exit 0 — the corpus zero-byte case (ADR-0055-empty.md) distinguishes nothing because trim(0)=raw(0)=0 (measured identical in both builds).

verdicts.evidence: Four siblings KILLED in this function (the three `", "` separators and the filter of directories already named), two of which were only caught after adding an extra journal and then a fourth: sensitivity there is established twice over. The survivor is `!abs || !hit` -> `&&`, where both operands are always true or false TOGETHER (`locateAdr` returns `abs` and `hit` from the same `find`), across the 16 layouts measured. METHOD OF THIS PASS (identical for every verdict below, closed on 2026-09-18). The mutant is APPLIED to the build, a behaviour probe calls the product on inputs that reach the mutated line, and a canonical digest of 250+ observations is compared: pointer grammar over 34 cells, manifest sections over 12 documents (renamed heading, lowercase, deep, last, duplicated, inside a code block, unclosed block), decision journals over 16 layouts, nine real missions read by evidenceReport/evidenceBreakdown/collectSealableEvidence/requiresLedger/prosePointerLedger/computeVerdict in strict AND non-strict, and the exact bounds of the signature guard (30, 119, 120, 121, 511, 512, 513). COVERAGE VERIFIED: the 56 instructed survivors are all on a line the probe EXECUTES, measured by NODE_V8_COVERAGE taking the innermost range (the first version marked 1540 lines out of 1540 and measured nothing). SENSITIVITY PROVEN: on this same pass, 20 mutants moved the probe and are now KILLED by tests written after reading the difference — so the instrument does tell what changes from what does not. The probe was wrong six times before it was right, and its failure mode was always to answer "equivalent": branches not reached, messages cut at 200 characters, verdict truncated at 4000, wrong mutated occurrence chosen. Each correction surfaced changing mutants that would have been filed wrongly.
